RED STUDIO / OUR PRACTICE

INDEPENDENT. INTERCONNECTED.

A studio for
ideas that move.

We are Red Studio. We bring brand, digital, motion, and sound into the same conversation. Every discipline adds something the others cannot.

We follow an idea from its first question to its final detail: a visual identity with character, an interface that feels natural, a film with a rhythm, or a sound that stays with you.

Identity & graphic design +

Brand strategy, visual identities, art direction, graphic systems, editorial design, and packaging.

Digital & UX/UI +

Research, user experience, interface design, design systems, websites, and interactive experiences.

Motion & 3D +

Animation, moving identities, 3D art, film titles, real-time environments, and interaction choreography.

Sound & sonic identity +

Original sound design, sonic signatures, composition, and audio for products and experiences.
LET’S THREAD SOMETHING TOGETHER.
